create.name: Travis Eliot
create.bio:
Travis Eliot is a Los Angeles yoga and meditation teacher who first learned to meditate as a child, when his mother brought home guided recordings. He trained in filmmaking and worked in television before a first class at Santa Monica Power Yoga turned his attention to yoga; a near-death experience on Kauai and surviving the 2004 tsunami in Thailand later settled the direction of his life. He is also a kirtan musician and a certified Ayurveda practitioner, and holds the E-RYT 500 credential.

With his wife, the teacher Lauren Eckstrom, he co-founded Inner Dimension, an online platform of cinematic yoga and meditation programmes, and the pair co-wrote Holistic Yoga Flow; his solo book, A Journey Into Yin Yoga, explores the slower, held side of practice. His teaching moves between vigorous flowing classes, which he calls Holistic Yoga Flow and Chi Warrior Flow, and quiet yin and restorative sessions, with breathwork and short talks on applying the practice to daily life. His free YouTube channel carries hundreds of full-length classes, and he leads retreats in places such as New Zealand, Italy and Mexico as well as hybrid teacher trainings with Lauren.

books.title: Holistic Yoga Flow: The Path of Practice
books.author: Travis Eliot and Lauren Eckstrom
books.description: A full guide to the couple's flowing style of yoga, covering postures, sequencing, breath and meditation alongside the wider philosophy of practice. Useful for students and teachers alike.

books.title: A Journey Into Yin Yoga
books.author: Travis Eliot
books.description: An introduction to yin yoga, the slow practice of holding floor postures for several minutes. He explains the poses and the reasoning behind them, and offers sequences to try at home.

courses.title: Mexico Yoga Retreat – Regenerative Series with Travis Eliot
courses.description: A week of yoga and rest in Zihuatanejo on Mexico's Pacific coast, led by Travis. Listed on his retreats page for December 2026.

courses.title: New Zealand Yoga Retreat with Travis Eliot and Lauren Eckstrom
courses.description: A retreat in Queenstown with both teachers, combining daily practice with time in the mountains and lakes of New Zealand's South Island.

courses.title: Yellowstone Yoga Retreat with Travis Eliot and Lauren Eckstrom
courses.description: A short retreat at Yellowstone National Park with the two teachers, setting yoga and meditation sessions against the park's wild landscape.

courses.title: Puglia Yoga Retreat with Travis Eliot and Lauren Eckstrom
courses.description: A week in southern Italy with the couple, with daily yoga and meditation in the countryside of Puglia.
